{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine turtleneck: slim fit, hip length, cream #EFE6D8, merino wool
Tailored trousers: straight leg, high rise, full length to the ankle, dark chocolate #3E2B22, wool crepe
Textured blazer: single-breasted, slightly fitted, hip length, heathered camel #B08A62, wool tweed
Overcoat: single-breasted, knee length, charcoal #3A3F47, dense wool-blend with a warm lining
Ankle boots: low block heel, treaded rubber sole, espresso #2B1F1A, waterproof sealed leather
Scarf: wide and soft, wrapped at the neck, burgundy #6E2233, wool-cashmere blend
Gloves: wrist length, espresso #2B1F1A, lined leather
Tote bag: structured, holds papers, espresso #2B1F1A, grained leather that wipes clean

This outfit stays within a neat business look: a refined knit, tailored trousers and a textured tweed blazer. The overcoat, lined gloves and scarf keep you warm in the frost and snow, and the blazer adds a second warm layer for your 20-minute walk. The waterproof boots with a treaded sole give grip on snow and resist road salt, and the full-length trousers sit just at the boot so no hem drags through slush. The cream, camel and chocolate tones suit your warm skin, dark hair and brown eyes, while the burgundy scarf adds a rich accent near your face."}
